title: Hierakonpolis. Part I. Plates of Discoveries in 1898
version: Egyptian Research Account, Fourth Memoir, London, Bernard Quaritch, 1900, with notes on plates by Petrie. Petrie Project transcription and facsimile entry.
lineage: Original excavation publication of the object, including a developed drawing. The interpretation in the plate notes is an early reading of the same carved witness cited by Manning.

passages.locator: pp. 9–10, note to Pl. XXVIc and Pl. XXVIc
passages.note: The note reads the scene as a king inaugurating irrigation works and identifies figures working at a canal. It does not claim the depiction records transverse basin dykes or a measured canal network.
passages.quote: Two men are engaged in making the banks on opposite sides of a canal
